notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, random arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Strong activations are all on mid-name sub-tokens of Spanish/Basque/Latin surnames (arr, Mon, Rob, Az) right after a first name, in lists of people or bylines; the negative pole is the same position with Al/Pal/Cal-type pieces. Near misses drop the surname but keep the first name, frame and language.
